biocs.name: Suspicious Process Execution from Temp Folder
biocs.description: Detects process execution originating from the Windows temp directory
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'Temp' and action_process_image_name contains '\\malware.exe'
